---
title: "Lab members"
---

## Timeline
```{=html}
  <style>
    .bar { fill: #E57200; }
    .axis-label, .tick text {
        font-size: 14px;
    }
    #timeline-chart {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
    }

    #tooltip {
      position: absolute;
      opacity: 0;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid #ccc;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 13px;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1000;
    }
  </style>

  <div id="chart-container" style="width: 100%;">
    <svg id="timeline-chart" viewBox="0 0 800 300" preserveAspectRatio="xMinYMin meet"></svg>
  </div>

  <div id="tooltip"></div>

  <script>
  function renderChart() {
    const container = document.getElementById("chart-container");
    const svg = d3.select("#timeline-chart");
    svg.selectAll("*").remove();  // Clear previous drawing

    const fullWidth = container.clientWidth;
    const fullHeight = 300;

    const margin = { top: 30, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 125};
    const width = fullWidth - margin.left - margin.right;
    const height = fullHeight - margin.top - margin.bottom;

    const chart = svg
      .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${fullWidth} ${fullHeight}`)
      .append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);

    // Parse dates and handle "now"
    d3.json("members.json").then(data => {
        // Parse dates
        data.forEach(d => {
          d.start = new Date(d.start);
          d.end = d.end === "now" ? new Date() : new Date(d.end);
        });

        // Scales
        const x = d3.scaleTime()
          .domain([d3.min(data, d => d.start), d3.max(data, d => d.end)])
          .range([0, width]);

        const y = d3.scaleBand()
          .domain(data.map(d => d.name))
          .range([0, height])
          .padding(0.2);

        // Axes
        chart.append("g")
          .call(d3.axisLeft(y));

        chart.append("g")
          .call(d3.axisTop(x)
          .ticks(d3.timeMonth.every(1))
          .tickFormat(d3.timeFormat("%b %Y")))
          .selectAll("text")
          // .attr("transform", "rotate(-45)")
          .style("text-anchor", "center");

        const tooltip = d3.select("#tooltip");
        // Bars
        chart.selectAll("rect")
          .data(data)
          .join("rect")
          .attr("class", "bar")
          .attr("y", d => y(d.name))
          .attr("x", d => x(d.start))
          .attr("width", d => x(d.end) - x(d.start))
          .attr("height", y.bandwidth())
          .on("mouseover", (event, d) => {
            const format = d3.utcFormat("%b %d, %Y");
            tooltip.transition().duration(200).style("opacity", 0.95);
            tooltip.html(`<strong>${d.name}</strong><br>${format(d.start)} → ${format(d.end)}`);
          })
          .on("mousemove", event => {
            tooltip.style("left", (event.pageX + 10) + "px")
                  .style("top", (event.pageY - 28) + "px");
          })
          .on("mouseout", () => {
            tooltip.transition().duration(200).style("opacity", 0);
        });
      });
    }

    // Initial render
    renderChart();

    // Re-render on window resize (with debounce)
    let resizeTimeout;
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
      resizeTimeout = setTimeout(renderChart, 150);
    });
  </script>
```
